text:
katie: Rolling runtime-2.19.0 to canary (global-canary) at 2026-06-12T14:00Z. Deploybot applied an automatic pin for model-group 'rerank-xlarge' after seeing non-deterministic sharding behavior in dynamic-batcher. Observed small rank score variance and a handful of 5xxs. Should we hold the pin and triage?

deploybot: Deploy record: runtime-2.19.0 -> canary started 2026-06-12T14:00Z. Auto-pin: soft (scope=cohort=canary, group=rerank-xlarge). Observability tags: dynamic-batcher, sharding, rerank. Link: https://deploy.redwood/6365001234 :robot_face:

harry: Quick paste from canary logs: ```
[14:05:11] pod p-42: batcher: shard_count=4 -> assigned 1 shard; unexpected shard overflow
[14:05:11] pod p-42: rpc: handler error: downstream split mismatch => 502
[14:07:00] pod p-73: rerank: score_delta: +0.007, -0.012 across repeats
```
Affected volume ~0.6% of canary requests, rerank recall delta ~0.4% on our small eval set.

ops-sre: Because this touches sharding logic I recommend three immediate mitigations: 1) convert hard-pin->soft-pin (already soft) and keep it 2) apply route rule to force high-concurrency tenants (>200 concurrent) to runtime-2.18 until we verify shard balancing 3) temporarily cap dynamic-batcher.max_shards to 2 on canary to avoid overflow. Example route patch: ```json
{"routes": [{"if": "concurrency>200","to": "runtime-2.18"}, {"else":"runtime-2.19"}], "batcher_config": {"max_shards": 2}}
```
I can push those changes now; also propose an auto-rollback hook: if rerank_recall_drop > 1.0% sustained 10m OR 5xx_rate > 0.8% sustained 5m -> rollback to runtime-2.18.

maria: I'll update release notes and the console banner with a compatibility blurb: "runtime-2.19 introduces dynamic-batcher improvements and sharding; customers using custom routing or low-level shard controls may observe transient rerank variance. Mitigations: routing to previous runtime, update SDK hints, or set batcher.max_shards." Also mailing list to Dedicated customers with reranking workloads.

release-manager: Timeline question: how long do we keep the pin if metrics are stable? previous threads typically used 1h; propose 2h for this since sharding fixes may take time to propagate.

katie: 2h sounds sensible. We'll keep soft-pin for 2h and run a focused regression eval every 5m. Harry, can you run the repeatability suite on canary pods after ops-sre applies caps?

harry: Kicked off repeatability suite at 14:12Z. Early signals: shard overflow errors dropped to 0.05% after reducing max_shards. Rerank recall delta back to ~0.15%. Artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/repeat/6365001234.

ops-sre: Applied route + batcher cap at 14:10Z. Also added a temporary throttling rule for batch_token_limit=1024 on canary nodes to reduce memory pressure. Hooked monitoring: alert if p95 latency > 900ms or retried shards > 0.5% over 5m.

maria: Release note draft added: "2.19.0 dynamic-batcher: improved throughput but new sharding semantics. Known issue: transient shard overflows for extreme concurrency; temporary mitigations available. Recommended: upgrade clients to include X-RW-BATCH-HINT or set batcher.max_shards." PR: https://docs.redwood/changes/2.19.0.

release-manager: Ok plan summary: 1) keep soft-pin for 2h 2) applied route to divert concurrency>200 to runtime-2.18 3) reduced max_shards to 2 and batch_token_limit to 1024 on canary 4) run repeatability suite every 5m 5) auto-rollback triggers set (recall_drop>1% 10m OR 5xx>0.8% 5m) 6) maria to update notes and customer outreach. If alarms fire -> deploybot rollback to runtime-2.18 and incident comms. :thumbsup:

harry: Follow-up: after 25m, all canary pods show stable shard assignments; rerank delta held at 0.12% and 5xxs ~0.02%. No rollback needed so far.

katie: Good. We'll let the 2h window run. If stable at end, remove pin and schedule a phased rollout to 20% regional traffic tomorrow with the batcher caps removed. If small regressions reappear during regional rollout, we should be prepared to reinstate cap and/or pause rollout.

ops-sre: Added a canary dashboard and a post-mortem template in case of rollback: https://ops.redwood/playbooks/pin-rollbacks. Also wired deploybot to post automatic notice to #incidents if rollback executes.

maria: Finalizing reach-outs to affected Dedicated tenants in the next 15m. I'll also add an ops KB on how to set X-RW-BATCH-HINT in route maps for on-prem/private setups.

katie: Closing loop for now. Thanks team — keeping this thread pinned to the canary watchlist. Will post a final status after the 2h window. :eyes: :rocket:
